Record Class SurfaceDrawContext.SortKey

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
icyllis.arc3d.granite.SurfaceDrawContext.SortKey
Record Components:
orderKey - 32-16 painter's order, 16-0 stencil disjoint set index
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<SurfaceDrawContext.SortKey>
Enclosing class:
SurfaceDrawContext
public static record SurfaceDrawContext.SortKey(Draw draw, int orderKey, long pipelineKey, int[] textures) extends Record implements Comparable<SurfaceDrawContext.SortKey>
The sorting is used to minimize state change.

Sorting order: painter's order, stencil disjoint set index, render step index, pipeline index, geometry uniform index, fragment uniform index, texture and sampler binding
